legos.why: 'இன்னும்' means both 'more' (더, here) and 'still/yet' elsewhere in the course, so the bare prompt has two answers. L34: 'one English prompt with two target answers: FIRST try to unify to one target form; only if the target language genuinely needs both, put one inside a larger LEGO, and that LEGO must make clear WHY it differs'. Grown to its seed piece 'இன்னும் அதிகமாக | 더 많이' (3 syllables; 'அதிகமாக | 많이' is the next LEGO and overlaps by design). Each row gains 많이 / அதிகமாக. Read row by row (R0.13).

'இல்லை | 없어요': 'இல்லை' is not a word of seed 57's Tamil (it is the tail of முடியவில்லை, 'cannot') (L26: 'a LEGO may contain only words its own seed says, on the known side and the target side alike'. ), and as a bare prompt it has other answers. Grown to the seed's piece 'நினைவில் கொள்ள முடியவில்லை | 기억할 수 없어요' (7 syllables, kept at 7: 수 없어요 leans on its verb). Five rows already say it; three ('왜 없어요') are rewritten.

HOLD — the clash is in the seed sentences themselves. L34 says 'first try to unify', and unifying here means changing a seed sentence, which is Kai's call (L25: 'bring to me and discuss'). 'தயாராக இல்லை' is 되지 않았어요 here (seed 88) and 안 됐어요 at seed 96 — and seed 88 says 안 됐어요 in both sister courses (kor_for_eng, kor_for_hin). Recommended: seed 88's Korean takes 안 됐어요, this LEGO and its 7 rows with it.
